You walked through Kakariko a hundred times,
but you never asked why its dead are buried on top of a temple full of guillotines.
Kakariko began as a village of the Sheikah, the shadows who guarded Hyrule's royal family.
Under the graveyard sits the Shadow Temple.
A wall inside reads: "Here is gathered Hyrule's bloody history of greed and hatred."
Blades drop from the ceiling, spiked walls close in, and some floors are invisible.
To see them you need the Lens of Truth, hidden under the village well,
where a pale thing called Dead Hand waits.
Impa sealed an evil shadow in that well.
When it broke loose, Kakariko burned,
and Bongo Bongo waited in the temple below.
The game never says who suffered down there.
Many fans think the Sheikah did the royal family's dirty work in those rooms.
That part is theory. The words on that wall come from the game itself.
